selected_scope: Contextual inspector foundation with Cell, Building, and Interference sample as the designed entity families; reuse existing read-only renderers for existing map feature types during relocation. Pareto, Run and Report remain outside inspector.
test_layers: App workflow tests with mocked existing data/services

cases.setup: Open Select/Inspect map mode, click a stable Cell marker in Inspect mode.
cases.assert: Right inspector names exact Cell ID and shows only effective/available RF values; active transmitter, cluster membership, Map Focus, Run source and planDirty do not change.

cases.setup: Use Select-cells mode in Single and Network modes.
cases.assert: Single selects active transmitter; Network adds/removes the clicked member and updates order/count exactly as current behavior. No inspection-only action silently selects.

cases.setup: Arm area draw, cell placement, or path-endpoint selection, then click a tower/result feature.
cases.assert: Armed task consumes pointer/keyboard action; inspector does not open until mode is explicitly exited.

cases.setup: Click a viewport building in Inspect mode.
cases.assert: Inspector shows stable ID and returned evidence; asynchronous response is cancelled/ignored if a different feature is inspected.

cases.setup: Open current interference layer and inspect a sample.
cases.assert: Only source-backed RSRP/SINR/RSRQ/serving/interferer facts display; sample stays tied to exact result context.

cases.setup: Open inspector by pointer and keyboard, then Close/Escape.
cases.assert: Inspector closes without changing Plan selection or left tool; keyboard focus returns to initiating feature/toolbar when available.

cases.setup: Configure Propagation, inspect a Cell, then change tool or return.
cases.assert: Propagation controls and unsaved state are preserved; inspector can stay open across supported desktop tool switches.

cases.setup: Inspect a Cell, then switch Scenario/Project.
cases.assert: Inspector closes/clears before new plan data loads; no prior Scenario tower/payload survives or flashes.

cases.setup: Inspect a result sample, then make RF-affecting plan edit.
cases.assert: No computation occurs; retained sample is labeled STALE with exact source Run, or UNAVAILABLE if source sample bytes are not retained.

cases.setup: Inspect entity whose data is missing/removed or whose async detail request fails.
cases.assert: Show explicit UNAVAILABLE reason and owning-tool action; do not substitute nearby feature or fabricate metrics.

cases.setup: Activate Edit in Inventory from Cell inspector.
cases.assert: Inventory opens with exact cell selected; only Inventory owns editable profile fields; edit invalidation follows current policy.

cases.setup: Open path profile for a cell/sample with supported endpoints.
cases.assert: Propagation > Advanced path profile opens with exact target/endpoints, no RF rerun and no silently changed plan inputs.

cases.setup: Open existing Pareto candidate detail from Results and use Apply or Run navigation.
cases.assert: Candidate remains Results-owned; Apply uses selected solution ID and exact Optimization Run/Version lineage; inspector does not duplicate or retarget it.

cases.setup: Open left task drawer and inspector at 1920 and 1600.
cases.assert: Both push; map remains broad and controls/layers do not overlap or clip.

cases.setup: Open both panels at 1440.
cases.assert: Right inspector overlays map, left task state stays intact, unobstructed map corridor remains usable; independent close recovers map.

cases.setup: Open inspector with task drawer active at 1280 and 1024.
cases.assert: Inspector occupies single drawer slot; no dual side panels; Back restores prior tool and map remains practical.

cases.setup: Open tool and inspector at 768 and 390.
cases.assert: One bottom sheet at a time; map retains broad visible region; no three-column layout or competing overlays.

cases.setup: Navigate stage, map inspect action, inspector actions and close using keyboard/AT.
cases.assert: Named inspector landmark and heading; source feature accessible name; visible focus; no focus trap; freshness is not color-only; pointer selection does not steal focus.

cases.setup: Cold start, open inspector for Cell/sample, then separately open RF Diagnostics Research, History, Report, Core Lab.
cases.assert: Inspector does not preload these chunks or issue requests; RF Diagnostics internal selection loads only the chosen research subview if split.

cases.setup: Repeat existing compute workflows before/after inspector navigation.
cases.assert: RF/optimization payloads, request counts, fingerprint/source identities and explicit compute action behavior are unchanged by inspect/open/close/tool navigation.

cases.setup: Compare serialized workspace and Run/Report outputs across inspector use.
cases.assert: No changes to ProjectV2, ScenarioRevision, Run schema, Reports, artifact bytes/integrity, data packs or API contracts.

required_invariants: No new global store, event bus, URL routing or plugin framework.
Current selection and inspector identity remain distinct.
Report artifact integrity and exact source lineage remain intact.
